title: Leads workspace
facts: The Leads workspace displays enquiries. Search and filters help narrow the list; the controls you can use depend on your account permissions.
Lead details expose additional workflows. This first browser adapter demonstrates the list; it does not change existing records.

title: Add a lead
facts: Add Lead opens a new lead form. Contact details, source and configured requirements are entered here. Required fields depend on your CRM configuration.
This demonstration opens the form and shows visible contact fields. It does not submit the form or create a record.

title: Lead sources
facts: Lead source and sub-source record where an enquiry originated. Available values depend on your organisation configuration.

The CRM source includes integration settings as well as manual entry and bulk upload. Availability of a specific provider requires configuration and verification; this demo does not connect external accounts.

title: Bulk lead upload
facts: The Leads module includes a bulk-upload screen. Use the template and validation guidance visible there to prepare an import.
This demonstration only opens the import screen. It does not select a file, upload data or start an import.

title: Projects workspace
facts: Projects organises project information. The CRM includes project details, blocks and units, amenities and a gallery.
This demonstration opens the project list. Account permissions determine which projects and actions are available.

title: Tasks workspace
facts: The Tasks workspace manages task records. Priority, status and scheduling controls depend on the task form and account permissions.
This demonstration opens Tasks. It does not create, complete or reassign a task.

title: Properties workspace
facts: The Properties module provides the property workspace. Available listings and controls depend on permissions.
This demonstration opens the module; it does not modify inventory or publish a listing.

title: Dashboard
facts: The Dashboard provides the CRM overview. Visible widgets and figures depend on your organisation and permissions.
This demonstration opens the dashboard without interpreting customer-specific figures.

title: Lead communication
facts: The CRM source contains lead email and WhatsApp communication workflows. Sending depends on configuration, permissions and the chosen communication channel.
This browser adapter currently demonstrates the Leads entry point only. It cannot yet verify the nested communication workflow and will not send messages.

title: Lead status
facts: Lead status is part of lead management. The available status values and permitted transitions depend on your CRM configuration.
This browser adapter currently shows the Leads entry point. Status editing is not enabled in this read-only demonstration.
